name: Steven Engineering
old_description: Steven Engineering is a distributor and custom manufacturer of switchgear. Offers arc resistant, generator control, high-current, low-voltage, and power distribution switchgear suitable for industrial, commercial, mechanical and marine applications.
about:
Steven Engineering, headquartered in Corona, California, was founded in 1975. The company operates as a distributor and contract manufacturer of industrial controls and components.

The company distributes and custom manufactures switchgear — including arc-resistant, generator control, high-current, low-voltage, and power distribution models — for industrial, commercial, mechanical, marine, and oil-and-gas applications. Beyond switchgear, Steven Engineering stocks more than 2.1 million industrial controls and components across categories such as automation, circuit protection, connectivity, enclosures, instrumentation, motor control, pneumatics, and relays. Its contract manufacturing services span custom design, product assembly, engraving, and kit assembly, supported by a workforce of 100 to 199 employees.

Steven Engineering serves customers in industrial, commercial, mechanical, marine, and oil-and-gas sectors. The company acts as a certified supplier to more than 450 clients and partners with major component manufacturers including Schneider Electric, Phoenix Contact, Honeywell Sensing and Control, and Rittal to provide a broad selection of controls and automation products.

The company emphasizes its documented procedures and certified supplier programs as differentiators, aiming to deliver consistent quality and integrate customer QA metrics into each step.
